summary: Enhance your skills with our Contract and Commercial Management Practitioner Training. Gain essential knowledge to excel in contract management and negotiations
lede: Contract and commercial management training covers the practical work of planning, sourcing and managing contracts and commercial relationships. It is for professionals in contract management, strategic sourcing, procurement, legal, sales and commercial roles who need to support effective contracting. The course develops capabilities in defining requirements, evaluating sourcing options and costs, auditing contract terms, and managing bid processes.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals involved in contract management and strategic sourcing.
modules: The Influence of Laws on the Bid Process
Statement of Work/Service Level Agreement Production
prerequisites: There are no specific prerequisites for this course; however, familiarity with contract and commercial management concepts is beneficial.
